seoTitle: Copy, Paste Text and Duplicate Pages in Squarespace
metaDescription: Paste text into a Squarespace text block and duplicate full pages, plus fixes if copy-paste isn't working as expected.
intro: Whether you're pasting plain text into a block or cloning a full page layout, Squarespace supports both, though the process isn't always obvious. This guide covers pasting text correctly, duplicating a page, and troubleshooting when copy-paste doesn't seem to work.

steps.heading: Log in and enter edit mode
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select your site, and click Edit to enter Edit Mode where content changes are made.

steps.heading: Add a text block and paste your content
steps.body: Click Add Block, choose Text, then open the editor and paste using right-click Paste or the Ctrl+V / Command+V shortcut.

steps.heading: Confirm and save
steps.body: Click OK to confirm the pasted text, then click Save so the update appears on the live site.

steps.heading: Duplicate a full page
steps.body: Go to the Pages panel, click the gear icon next to the page you want to copy, and choose Duplicate Page to clone its structure.

steps.heading: Copy individual sections between pages
steps.body: Click the section you want to copy, use your browser's copy function or keyboard shortcut, then paste it into another section of your site.

faq.question: Why can't I paste text in Squarespace?
faq.answer: Make sure you're pasting inside a supported block like Text or Code, not in preview mode, and not pasting incompatible formatting from another app.

faq.question: Is there a one-click way to duplicate a page?
faq.answer: Squarespace doesn't have a single-click copy option, but the Duplicate Page feature under the gear icon achieves the same result.

faq.question: What should I do if copy-paste still isn't working?
faq.answer: Try refreshing your browser or switching to Chrome or Firefox for better compatibility.

faq.question: Can I copy a section from one page and paste it into another?
faq.answer: Yes, click the section, copy it using your browser menu or keyboard shortcut, then paste it into the target page.
